why: Anyone reading these skip reasons reasonably concludes overflow coverage for ParentSettingsScreen, PointConfigScreen, RewardConfigurationScreen, StudyDayConfigScreen, CurriculumProgressScreen, CurriculumSettingsScreen, LearningOrderScreen, ParentTrackManagementScreen, TutorAuditLogScreen, InviteTutorScreen, AcceptInviteScreen, DeclineInviteScreen, PinFlowSetupRoute and PinFlowVerifyRoute is handled by a device sweep. It is not: integration_test/app_test.dart is the ONLY on-device test file in the repo (no other file exists under integration_test/, no flutter-drive/Firebase-Test-Lab target in the Makefile or .github/workflows) and it only asserts the app widget mounts after launch. These 14 screens — several of them PIN-gated parent/reward-money surfaces — have zero automated overflow verification anywhere, contrary to what the comment tells the next reader.
recommendation: Either write the actual on-device sweep (integration_test/ + flutter drive/Test Lab target) and point the comment at its file:line, or replace 'swept on device' with an honest 'untested — DNI-#### tracks the device sweep' per AG-6, or find a headless workaround the way the file already did for screens 11-27.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 14 skip reasons either links to a real, currently-passing on-device test file:line, or is replaced with an accurate gap description plus a DNI-#### ticket.
A repo-wide grep for 'swept on device' in test/ resolves to an actual test file when followed.
